documents.text:
This amendment is dated 1 May 2025. It takes effect only when both parties sign.
The original agreement is not provided.
documents.scope_note: Only this amendment is supplied. Do not infer terms of the unavailable original agreement.

documents.text: Northbridge Labs Ltd (Northbridge) and Cedar Systems Ltd (Cedar) are the parties.
documents.scope_note: Identify the named entities in the supplied sentence, without counting aliases as extra entities.

documents.text: Only the storage-space licence may be ended on 14 days' notice. The services agreement otherwise continues.
documents.scope_note: The storage-space licence and the services agreement have different scopes.

documents.text: Section A specifies a fee of twelve percent (18%). The parties have not resolved this discrepancy.
documents.scope_note: Preserve the conflicting written and numeric fee; do not choose a corrected rate.
